heading: Presumption as to [6][Electronic Signature Certificates]
text: The Court shall presume, unless contrary is proved, that the information listed in a [7][Electronic Signature Certificate] is correct, except for information specified as subscriber information which has not been verified, if the certificate was accepted by the subscriber.]
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by ibid., s. 52, for “Digital Signature Certificate” (w.e.f. 27.10.2009).
Subs. by the A.O. 1950, for “any country not forming part”.
